- **Best-of-three matches now cover every format** (issue #90): Duel, Open Team Play, Closed Team Play, and Traditional, plus a visual card-toggle sideboarding picker for Power Duel's game 2/3, and fixes for team matches not ending after 2 wins, a missing "next game" button, and lobby grouping/win credit for team matches.
- **New "Tactical Bot" AI tier** (issue #419): a search-based practice bot that actually looks ahead instead of following fixed heuristics, split into three speed tiers, with fixes so it no longer burns its full thinking budget on empty-hand or single-card turns.
- **Numerous practice-bot AI fixes** across many mood cards (Rationalization, Ambition, Guilt, Rejection, Scorn, Shock, Exhilaration, Fear, Denial, Grief, and more): bots now target opponents instead of themselves or nobody, hold cards back for genuinely good moments instead of wasting them, and stop hurting their own board.
- **New Steampunk/Futuristic/Neon card-art skins** for the four Chaos Draft token moods, plus Rationalization and Recklessness.
- **Game board improvements**: a collapsible recent-plays log, animated "bot is thinking" indicators, and a fix for Duplicity's own repeat text showing a raw array instead of readable text.
- **UI/theme fixes**: multi-select fields replaced with checkbox lists, lobby row highlight colors corrected on dark themes, a horizontal-scrollbar bug on desktop fixed, and the User info/Stats/Spectate pages now correctly apply the selected theme.
- Deck Builder: catalog "add to deck" actions moved into the card-detail popup.
- Assorted smaller fixes: chat/button padding and wrapping tightened across several pages, and development deploys are no longer announced on Discord.
